article.title: Provision for early childhood care and education to children below the age of six years
article.content:
45Provision for early childhood care and education to children below the age of six years

Article 45 · Part IV
1[The State shall endeavour to provide early childhood care and education for all children until they complete the age of six years.]

1 Subs. by the Constitution (Eighty-sixth Amendment) Act, 2002, s. 3, for art. 45 (w.e.f. 1-4-2010).
